Below $100,000 both use the Tax Table lookup; at or above it both enter the Tax Computation Worksheet, whose single remaining difference is the redundant lower bound on each section's first row recorded in the `tcw` log. The second transcription groups the joint and surviving-spouse statuses in one alternative where the project lists them separately with the same result; the comparison treats those as one case.
